description: The clean DDD reference project (clean/).

Gap probe, added after the first tool run to test a limit predicted from the extractor (it records no accessors or field modifiers): Quantity exposes a public `set value` accessor over a non-readonly field. The definition says FF-DT03 fires; the name proxy is expected to miss it.

expectedFindings.reason: Value object Quantity has a public setter (the `set value` accessor) and a non-readonly field (current).

description: Probe, added after the first tool run when the expected-graph edge OrderingAcl -> ordering/index.ts was missing (the extractor routes imports through barrels to the declaring file). ordering's barrel also publishes GetOrderSummary; the billing API (not the ACL) imports it through the barrel. By definition this goes through the public API: no finding.
Probe, companion of g02: the barrel publishes GetOrderSummary, but the billing API imports the declaring file directly, bypassing the barrel. By definition a violation of FF-DS02.

expectedFindings.reason: billing imports ordering's GetOrderSummary.ts directly; the file is re-exported by ordering's barrel, but the import does not go through it, and the importer is not in billing's ACL.

description: Negative control: billing's anti-corruption layer imports an internal ordering file (OrderId). The ACL exception of FF-DS02 allows it; no rule should fire.
GetOrderSummary (ordering application) names the inner entity OrderLine of the Order aggregate.

expectedFindings.reason: A file outside the Order aggregate module references OrderLine, an inner entity of Order; outside code may reference only the root (a type-only import is still a reference).

description: A repository interface OrderLineRepository for the inner entity OrderLine, placed inside the Order aggregate module (so the aggregate boundary itself is not crossed).

expectedFindings.reason: A repository's contract references OrderLine, an inner entity; repositories exist only for aggregate roots.
